crossRefs.note: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join…
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?”…
Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to…
Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

translations.web: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”
translations.bsb: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give me counsel. What should we do?”
translations.kjv: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.
translations.asv: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give your counsel what we shall do.
